sources.title: Police.uk publication method
sources.summary: Forces submit records each month. The public release reduces date and location precision and removes internal references.

sources.title: Police.uk API fields
sources.summary: The API provides category, month, approximate location and available outcome. Its numeric ID is not a police case reference.

sources.title: Police.uk crime categories
sources.summary: Violence and sexual offences combines common assault, grievous bodily harm and sexual offences. These rows cannot reveal the subtype.

sources.title: What police ask after a report
sources.summary: Police ask who, what, where and when. A forensic examination may be offered. Missing public fields do not show police indifference.

sources.title: Met investigation process
sources.summary: Detailed statements and relevant digital evidence can form part of an investigation. This guidance does not prove collection in these five records.

sources.title: Camden Safety Bus
sources.summary: The council lists a 12 September relocation outside KOKO. Published hours remain 21:30 to 02:30. Actual deployment is unconfirmed.

sources.title: Camden Safe Havens
sources.summary: The council lists a help scheme. Scheme membership does not establish current staffing or availability.

areaContext.title: Published women and girls safety priority
areaContext.summary: The police publish a Camden Town priority on violence against women and girls during the night-time economy.
areaContext.responseSummary: The source lists police operations and work with the council and licensing staff, including staff training.

areaContext.title: Safety Bus location exception
areaContext.summary: The 12 September council notice lists the Safety Bus outside KOKO on Camden High Street.
